lammps_guard.py performs repository-defined deterministic static checks; it does not prove native execution, numerical convergence, or physical validity.
lammps_manual.py exposes repository-defined offline catalog lookup and must not convert an index listing into an executable recipe.
The Skill keeps correctness, completion, convergence, and scientific acceptance as separate fail-closed gates.
A completed LAMMPS run or stable trajectory does not by itself establish convergence or scientific adequacy for the target observable.
